echo '== names tests/a.examples.test.ts'; git show HEAD:tests/a.examples.test.ts | grep -oE '(test|it)\("[^"]+"' | sed -E 's/^(test|it)\(//' | grep -vxF "\"A example 4: old\"" > $P/names || true; while IFS= read -r n; do grep -qF "$n" tests/a.examples.test.ts || { echo "test removed: $n"; exit 1; }; done < $P/names
echo '== names tests/b.examples.test.ts'; git show HEAD:tests/b.examples.test.ts | grep -oE '(test|it)\("[^"]+"' | sed -E 's/^(test|it)\(//' > $P/names || true; while IFS= read -r n; do grep -qF "$n" tests/b.examples.test.ts || { echo "test removed: $n"; exit 1; }; done < $P/names
